meta.purpose: Opt-in stat normalization (StatNormalizer): each men-at-arms group's Bannerlord damage and health follow its CK3 base stats (ck3_catalog.json maa_types[].damage/toughness). Levies and knight retinues are left alone.
meta.formula: damage factor = clamp(damage_scale * damage / baseline_damage), health factor = clamp(toughness_scale * toughness / baseline_toughness), both clamped to [clamp_min, clamp_max]; they multiply the group's existing groupBuffs (knights pass) and the product is clamped again. A stat of 0 (siege weapons) keeps a neutral factor.
meta.baseline: 30 / 20 are the medians of the 111 MaA types of ck3_catalog.json (CK3 1.20): a typical regiment stays at 1.0. Means (46 / 23) are pulled up by heavy cavalry and elephants; the levy (10 / 10) would push almost every MaA to clamp_max.
meta.off: normalization_mode "off" (default), a missing file or invalid values: the request is built exactly as without this file.
